Official Client Agreement & Policy

Terms and Conditions & Transparency Charter

YOUR DREAM | OUR GUIDANCE | GLOBAL OPPORTUNITIES • YOUR VISA • OUR PRIORITY

Below is the verbatim agreement issued to every candidate. We operate with zero false promises, complete fee transparency, 65-Day refund policy, and Pune/Mumbai jurisdiction.

📄
Official Printed Terms Document
Authorized document issued by Galaxy Star Work Permit Services

1. Scope of Services

Consultation and Guidance: The consultancy will provide guidance regarding the visa process, required documents, and application procedures.

Application Preparation: We will assist in preparing and submitting the application based on the information provided by the client.

No Guarantee of Visa Approval: The authority to approve or reject a visa rests entirely with the relevant Embassy/Consulate. The consultancy does not provide a 100% guarantee of visa approval.

Clause #1 • Legally Binding

2. Client's Responsibilities

Accurate Information: The client must provide all information, certificates, and documents that are true, accurate, and complete.

Fake Documents: If the client submits any fake or forged documents, the application may be rejected. The consultancy will not be responsible in such circumstances, and legal action may be taken.

Timely Compliance: The client is responsible for submitting the required documents and fees within the specified time.

Clause #2 • Legally Binding

3. Fees and Payment Policy

Service Charges: The client must pay the agreed consultancy fee as discussed at the beginning of the process.

Government Fees: Visa application fees, courier charges, medical examination fees, and other government charges must be paid separately by the client. If any such charges are borne by the company, the client will not be required to pay them separately.

Clause #3 • Legally Binding

4. Refund / Non-Refund Policy (65 Days Policy)

Refund Window (65 Days): If the client cancels the process due to personal difficulties, the amount paid will be refunded within 65 days.

Personal Reasons / Difficulties: If the client cancels the process due to any personal reasons or difficulties, no refund will be provided.

e-Visa Payment Window: After the e-visa is issued, the client must pay the remaining amount within a maximum of two days. If any problem arises during the process, the consultancy will not be held responsible.

Clause #4 • 65-Day Guarantee

5. Termination of Agreement

Cancellation of Agreement: If the client violates the terms, provides incorrect information, or fails to pay the agreed fees, the consultancy may terminate the agreement immediately.

No Refund: If the client voluntarily discontinues the process, the fees already paid will not be refunded.

Clause #5 • Legally Binding

6. Jurisdiction

Legal Jurisdiction: Any disputes or legal matters arising from this process shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts located in Pune/Mumbai, where the consultancy's main office is situated.

Clause #6 • Pune / Mumbai Courts
